tokens.note: Agent totals as the Agent tool reported them for each run. Not API cost: the make-up (input, cache reads, output) is not given and Claude Code's own overhead is inside.

predictions.title: Overall correctness
predictions.rule: S between 75 and 150 correct runs of 300; D and L each between 195 and 255.
predictions.numbers: S 149/300 (49.7%), D 298/300 (99.3%), L 295/300 (98.3%). S in band: True; D in band: False; L in band: False.

predictions.title: Where the gain comes from
predictions.rule: (D - S) >= 30 pp and -5 pp <= (L - D) <= +5 pp.

predictions.title: Clean requests
predictions.rule: S, D and L each >= 60 correct of 70 on the 14 clean requests, and best minus worst <= 5 runs.

predictions.title: Same answer every time
predictions.rule: Requests (of 60) with five matching runs: D >= 39, L >= 39, S <= 27.

predictions.title: Two departments, one number
predictions.rule: Paraphrase pairs (of 10) with the same majority result: D >= 7, L >= 7, S <= 5.

predictions.title: Company definitions
predictions.rule: On the 12 company-definition requests (60 runs per arm): D >= 45 correct, L >= 45, S <= 12.

predictions.title: Rigidity
predictions.rule: On the 4 override requests (20 runs per arm): D and L each have at most 2 runs matching the default-applied naive variant.

predictions.title: Problems nobody wrote down
predictions.rule: Fix-or-flag scoring: L >= 8 of its 20 undocumented-issue runs right, S <= 3, and without REQ-T16 L <= 7 of the remaining 15.
predictions.numbers: L 20/20 (repaired 20, flagged 0); S 5/20 (repaired 5, flagged 0); L without T16 15/15.

predictions.title: Token use
predictions.rule: Median agent tokens per run S < D < L, and L <= 1.15 x D.

predictions.title: Small model with the library
predictions.rule: (Haiku L - Sonnet S) >= 10 pp and (Sonnet L - Haiku L) >= 5 pp.
predictions.numbers: Haiku L 237/300 (79.0%), Sonnet S 149/300 (49.7%), Sonnet L 295/300 (98.3%); Haiku L - Sonnet S = 29.3 pp; Sonnet L - Haiku L = 19.3 pp.

predictions.title: Scripts
predictions.rule: |L - L-| <= 5 pp overall, and on the 12 script-targeted requests (60 runs) L has fewer than 6 more correct runs than L-.

predictions.title: Requests the library was not built for
predictions.rule: L's correct share on the 13 no-template requests is at least 10 pp below its share on the other 47.
